verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਨਮਿਤ ਮਾਝ ਹੀ ਬਸਤ ਬਗ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaat hai jagatr jaise teerath jaatraa namit maajh hee basat bag mahimaa na jaanee hai ||

en.bdb: Just as the whole world go to places of pilgrimage, but the egret living there has not appreciated the greatness of these places,

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਾਸਕਰਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਲੂ ਅੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਬੁਰੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਕਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pooran pragaas bhaasakar jagamag jot uloo a(n)dh ka(n)dh buree karanee kamaanee hai ||

en.bdb: Just as bright light spreads all around when the Sun rises, but an owl has committed so many ill deeds that he remains hidden in dark caves and burrows,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਸੰਤ ਸਮੈ ਸਫਲ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸੇਂਬਲ ਬਡਾਈ ਉਰ ਆਨੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau basa(n)t samai safal banaasapatee nihafal se(n)bal baddaiee ur aanee hai ||

en.bdb: Just as all vegetation bears flowers and fruits during spring season but a cotton silk tree who has brought in him the praise of being big and mighty, remains bereft of flowers and fruits.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ ਚਾਖਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜੁਗਤ ਬਕਬਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥੫੨੫॥
verses.translit_en: moh gur saagar mai chaakhio nahee prem ras tirakhaava(n)t chaatrik jugat bakabaanee hai ||525||

en.bdb: Despite living near the vast ocean like True Guru, I, the unfortunate one, had not tasted the divine elixir obtained by His loving worship. I have only been making noise of my thirst like a rain-bird. I have only indulged in empty arguments and contemplations.  (525)
